summary: Integrated the user-provided character reference sheet into a 6-beat, 51.2s character-led GPU explainer proof, built on top of TASK-007's storyboard. The reference sheet at assets/character/character_reference_sheet.png (1536x1024 PNG, renamed from the as-saved character_reference_sheet.png.png -- filename only, content untouched) reads visually as a flat moodboard, but its alpha channel is already cleanly pre-matted per pose: composited onto white before writing any extraction code, the result showed clean edges with no visible halo. Per the task's instruction #6, poses were cropped (not pretended to be separate production assets) from the five labeled top-row portraits (reference/introg/explaining/thinking/closing), trimmed to each portrait's alpha bounding box above its debug label badge. One pose ('reference') has a genuine, unfixable soft-edge artifact at its own extended-hand boundary -- confirmed by testing increasing crop trims, which made it worse (cut into increasingly opaque arm content) rather than better -- so it was excluded from the render per the quality gate rather than shipped with a visible flaw; the other four poses are clean and were used across the 6 beats (with 2 reused once each, spaced apart). Diagrams (single-GPU core grid, CPU-vs-GPU comparison, cores+memory data flow, mini data->GPU-cluster->AI-model pipeline) reuse create_poc_scene's THEME/glow/caption primitives via two new generalized helpers, not a new engine.
